origin_values.api: Retrieved from OpenRouter's public API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models or /api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints) at fetch time, reformatted only (units, joins).
origin_values.enriched: Added by us: computed from API fields by a stated rule, or a judgement label. Not something OpenRouter publishes.

columns.name: snapshot_date
columns.description: UTC date the API was fetched. Same for every row of a file.

columns.name: model_listed_utc
columns.description: Date OpenRouter first listed the model (`created`, Unix time to UTC date). Not the date batch support arrived.

columns.name: model
columns.description: Sync model slug (`id` with `:batch` removed).

columns.name: batch_id
columns.description: Batch slug (`id`) to submit batches with.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Display name (`name`).

columns.name: context_length
columns.description: Context window in tokens (`context_length`).

columns.name: input_modalities
columns.description: `architecture.input_modalities`, `;`-separated.

columns.name: batch_input_usd_per_m
columns.description: Batch input price, US$ per million tokens (`pricing.prompt` x 1e6, base tier).

columns.name: batch_output_usd_per_m
columns.description: Batch output price, US$ per million tokens (`pricing.completion` x 1e6, base tier).

columns.name: sync_input_usd_per_m
columns.description: Input price of the sync id for the same model. Empty if the sync id is not listed.

columns.name: sync_output_usd_per_m
columns.description: Output price of the sync id for the same model. Empty if not listed.

columns.name: batch_providers
columns.description: Providers serving the `:batch` id, from `/api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints`, `;`-separated.

columns.name: canonical_slug
columns.description: `canonical_slug`: OpenRouter's permanent slug, usually the model name plus a release-date stamp.

columns.name: hugging_face_id
columns.description: `hugging_face_id`: weights repo for open-weight models. Empty for closed models.

columns.name: expiration_date
columns.description: `expiration_date`: announced retirement date. Empty if none announced.

columns.name: tier
columns.description: Cheap / Mid / Expensive by batch output price: < $3, $3-20, >= $20 per million. Rule: notebook/07-price-tiers.md, scripts/price_tiers.py.

columns.name: tier_rank
columns.description: 1 = Cheap, 2 = Mid, 3 = Expensive.

columns.name: input_band
columns.description: Cheap < 0.60, Mid 0.60-3.00, Expensive >= 3.00 (batch input $/M).

columns.name: input_mismatch
columns.description: True when input_band differs from tier: the model changes tier on input-heavy jobs.

columns.name: out_in_ratio
columns.description: batch_output_usd_per_m / batch_input_usd_per_m, 1 decimal.

columns.name: reference_job_usd
columns.description: Cost in US$ of 4.5M input + 0.5M output tokens at batch prices (bulk-labelling job shape, 9:1).

columns.name: stable_endpoint
columns.description: True if the id resolves to one fixed model version. False for dynamic aliases (`~` prefix or `latest` in the id, which OpenRouter says 'always redirects to the latest model') and for closed models whose canonical_slug has no date stamp (an upstream alias the provider can repoint). Rule: scripts/build_hf_dataset.py.

columns.name: stability_basis
columns.description: Which branch of the stable_endpoint rule applied.

columns.name: offers_cache_pricing
columns.description: True when the batch id's API record publishes a prompt-cache read price (`pricing.input_cache_read`). False means no cache price is listed, not proof the provider never caches.

columns.name: cache_pricing
columns.description: Cache prices from `pricing`, US$ per million tokens, as compact JSON: `read_usd_per_m` (`input_cache_read`), `write_usd_per_m` (`input_cache_write`, null when not published: usually automatic caching with no write premium), and `long_context` {`min_prompt_tokens`, `read_usd_per_m`, `write_usd_per_m`} when a long-context override lists cache prices. Empty when offers_cache_pricing is False.
